items.Sentence: The WWTF process includes an influent lift station with two submersible pumps.
the main lift station wet well is equipped with an emergency overflow that would convey sewer flows into an emergency storage pond until the operation of the lift pumps is restored.
Surface mechanical aerators are used in AP-1 and AP-1A to provide oxygen to the wastewater, keeping the ponds partially mixed.
The Facility consists of unlined aeration ponds followed by evaporation/percolation ponds.
Periodically, the aeration pond being used is taken out of service for solids management and wastewater is then conveyed to the other aeration pond.
